name: C.I.D Praha s.r.o.
summary: Czech arms supplier and SME based in Prague. It wins weapons contracts from the Czech Ministry of the Interior (Police of the Czech Republic) and the Ministry of Defence. Its main business on TED is 4.6×30 mm personal defence weapons (PDW submachine guns), supplied under framework agreements with spare parts and accessories. It also supplies spare parts and components for police long-gun systems. All its TED awards are in CPV 35300000.

offering.about: C.I.D Praha s.r.o. is a Prague-based firearms dealer that has operated on the Czech market since 1996, providing retail and wholesale sales of firearms, ammunition and accessories as well as trade in military material. It runs a physical shop in central Prague, has a wholesale division and offers discounts to members of the armed forces. It is the exclusive Czech civilian-market representative for several foreign manufacturers including Heckler & Koch, Sako, Fabarm, Hatsan, EOTECH and Sauvestre/Thifan.

catalogue.summary: Heckler & Koch-aligned weapons distributor and long-standing supplier to the Czech Police: 4.6×30 mm PDW submachine guns (MP7A1 family) under a 120-month MoI framework and Czech MoD call-offs, plus 72-month spare-parts frameworks covering HK G36, HK416/417, 9×19 mm SMGs (MP5), .308/.338 LM sniper rifles and 40×46 mm launchers. name: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition
summary: Rheinmetall's large weapons and ammunition company (Rheinmetall Waffe Munition, Unterlüß, Germany) and a main ammunition supplier to the Bundeswehr procurement office (BAAINBw). Its TED awards cover medium-calibre ammunition (30×173 mm DM58 practice rounds for IFVs, 40×53 mm HE and shaped-charge belted grenades), flash-bang hand grenades with training systems, and launcher equipment. It also exports to Nordic police forces, including a NOK 250M framework for 40×46 mm low-velocity CS and penetrating rounds for the Norwegian police.

contracts.buyer: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation
contracts.title: Anskaffelse af nyt Decoy Launching System til Søværnet
contracts.description:
Forsvarsministeriet Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelsen (FMI) har indgået kontrakt med Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH om anskaffelse af nyt Decoy Launching System til det danske Søværn. Specifikt har FMI indgået kontrakt om anskaffelse af fem systemer til fregatterne af ABSL- og IVER-kl. Leverandøren leverer som en del af anskaffelsen træning som en service. 

FMI har ydermere indgået en rammeaftale om genforsyning af ammunition samt aftale om vedligehold med leverandøren med en varighed på op til 20 år. Vedligeholdelseskontrakten indeholder følgende ydelser:
- Vedligehold
- Support
- Reservedele
- Træning

FMI gør opmærksom på, at Rheinmetall Protection Systems GmbH fremgik som leverandør i bekendtgørelse med henblik på frivillig forudgående gennemsigtighed. Det er imidlertid Rheinmetall Waffe

contracts.buyer: Bundesamt für Ausrüstung, Informationstechnik und Nutzung der Bundeswehr
contracts.title: E/K2BB/QA081/QA081 - 130mm Mun DM11 KPz LEOPARD 2
contracts.description: Entwicklung einer Gefechtsmunition (HE)  für die zukünftige Panzerkanone. Die Großkaliber-Panzerkanone stellt die Hauptbewaffnung des Kampfpanzers dar. In der gegebenen Projektzeit soll eine Gefechtsmunition, hochexplosiv (HE) entwickelt werden. Ziel ist es die Entwicklung der Multifunktions-Gefechtsmunition für die zukünftige großkalibrige Panzerkanone im gegebenen Zeitrahmen voranzutreiben. Die Leistungsbeschreibung umfasst hierbei notwendige (Weiter-)Entwicklungen von Technologien und Werkstoffen sowie den Aufbau und die Erprobung der Munition.

Ziel ist es durch die dedizierte Auslegung dieser Munition auf die Qualifizierung der Waffe, den Kosten- und Zeitrahmen möglichst ökonomisch zu halten.

offering.about: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH (RWM), headquartered in Unterlüß, Germany, is Rheinmetall's weapons and ammunition subsidiary and describes itself as a leading supplier of weapon systems and ammunition for infantry, direct and indirect fire, pyrotechnics and protection systems. It was formed in 2004 from five predecessor companies including Mauser-Werke Oberndorf and BUCK Neue Technologien. It makes the main gun of the Leopard 2, artillery and medium-calibre ammunition, 40mm ammunition and pyrotechnic grenades for the Bundeswehr and other NATO forces.

product_portfolio.details: 155mm shells produced at the new Unterlüß plant; target of about 140,000 rounds in 2026 and up to 350,000 rounds/year from 2027.
30mm ammunition for the Puma IFV under a Bundeswehr framework contract (Dec 2022, extended to about EUR 1 billion, running to 2029). Medium-calibre centre of excellence shared with RWM Schweiz AG.

products: 40mm low-velocity HE and practice grenades (via Rheinmetall Waffe Munition ARGES, Austria)
product_portfolio.details: 40mm x 53 HV rounds: muzzle velocity above 240 m/s, maximum effective range 2,200 m; fit standard 40mm automatic grenade launchers; qualified for the Bundeswehr and other NATO forces.
DM45 ('Granate, Hand, DM45, 800 g'): framework contract for up to 1.5 million; first order of 962,860 to be delivered 2024-2027, produced at Silberhütte (Harz).

offering.production_capabilities: HQ and main plant at Unterlüß. Other German sites: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Oberndorf, Neuenburg am Rhein, Schneizlreuth, Trittau and Harzgerode/Silberhütte; subsidiary in Rijswijk (NL). Says it runs the largest private-sector proving grounds in Europe (Unterlüß, plus Ochsenboden, CH). New 155mm plant at Unterlüß (EUR 500 million, 50,000 m2, opened Aug 2025) has a case-manufacturing complex (forging/machining) and an LAP (filling, assembly, packaging) complex. Output was planned at 25,000 rounds in 2025, 140,000 in 2026 and 350,000/year from 2027. Rocket motor production there starts in 2026.

current_offers.description: New plant opened 2025, about 140,000 rounds planned for 2026 and full capacity of 350,000 rounds/year from 2027. Rocket motor production for artillery rockets starts in 2026.
Bundeswehr framework contract extended to about EUR 1 billion (to 2029). New call-off worth several hundred million euros for a medium six-figure number of rounds.
Framework agreement between BAAINBw and RWM for up to 1.5 million grenades. First order of 962,860 (EUR 67 million) delivered in annual instalments 2024-2027.
Bundeswehr orders for DM131 ABM rounds (about EUR 22.9 million) and about 200,000 DM158 practice rounds (about EUR 7.2 million).

offering.notes: Press releases often name only 'Rheinmetall' rather than the RWM subsidiary. The 155mm plant, Puma and 40mm orders are attributed to RWM because they are made at RWM sites (Unterlüß HQ), but not every release names the legal entity. The DM45 contract is explicitly signed with RWM. The Bundeswehr's DM51 fragmentation hand grenade is made by Diehl Defence, not Rheinmetall, so the hand grenades in TED notices are probably pyrotechnic types such as DM45. No group-level employee count specific to RWM was verified (a job portal claims 10,000+, which likely refers to the whole group). The Baltic orders source was found in search but not opened.

proven: Medium-calibre ammunition for the Bundeswehr: 30×173 mm DM58 practice rounds and 40×53 mm belted HE-frag/shaped-charge and practice grenades
Gun barrel and cradle assemblies (Rohrwaffenbaugruppe), launchers (TKWA MASS, 40 mm ROSY) and equipment maintenance for BAAINBw
Export wins: 120 mm tank practice ammunition for the Spanish Army (€13.2M) and a 4-year framework for 40×46 mm low-velocity CS and penetrating rounds for the Norwegian police
offered: Large-calibre: Leopard 2 120 mm gun, 155 mm artillery ammunition (Unterlüß plant ramping to 350,000 rounds a year from 2027), sensor-fuzed rounds, rocket motors
Medium-calibre: 30×173 mm KE-TF DM21 airburst, KE DM33, MK30-2/ABM cannon; 40 mm ABM DM131 airburst and low-velocity grenades
Infantry pyrotechnics: DM45 smoke hand grenades, stun and illumination grenades

catalogue.summary: German weapons and ammunition manufacturer with 32 TED lots, mainly sole-source Bundeswehr orders: 40×53 mm grenade ammunition (DM131 airburst, DM158 practice, HE/HEDP mixed belts), 30×173 mm DM33 and DM58 for the Puma, pyrotechnic hand grenades (DM45 smoke up to 1.5M, DM149/DM159/DM169 stun, DM59 simulators), and Leopard 2 gun barrels and cradles. Export wins cover 120 mm practice tank ammunition for Spain (EUR 13.2M) and 40×46 mm LV CS/penetrating rounds for Norwegian police. It also supplies and supports TKWA MASS/ROSY softkill launchers and offers 30 mm DM21 airburst and 155 mm artillery ammunition.

name: Fabryka Broni "ŁUCZNIK"-Radom Sp. z o.o.
summary: Polish state-group small-arms manufacturer in Radom (Łucznik), maker of the MSBS GROT rifle. On TED it mostly wins spare parts, service and repair kits, gauges, special tools, and UTM training-ammunition conversion kits for Polish Army small arms. It supplies these to Regional Logistics Bases 1 and 2, often as call-offs under framework agreement 19/W/2024. Platforms covered include the 5.56 mm MSBS GROT and the 9 mm PM-84P and PM-98 submachine guns.

offering.about: Fabryka Broni 'Łucznik' - Radom is a state-owned Polish small-arms maker in Radom and part of Polska Grupa Zbrojeniowa (PGZ). It makes the MSBS GROT modular rifle family, Beryl carbines, VIS pistols, grenade launchers and submachine guns for the Polish Armed Forces, the Ministry of Interior, civilian buyers and export. The factory marked its 100th anniversary in 2025 and opened a new production hall that year.

product_portfolio.details: GROT A3: 5.56mm NATO, 700-900 rds/min, muzzle velocity 890 m/s, effective range 500 m. Modular design for conventional and bullpup layouts. Slimmer handguard, improved gas regulator, reinforced stock mount. Developed with the Military University of Technology (WAT).

name: TRANSCARPAT SPORTOURS INTERNATIONAL
summary: Medium-sized Romanian defence and security trading company in Bucharest. It supplies the Romanian MoD (several military units), the Romanian Police, the Border Police, the Penitentiary Police and the emergency services (IGSU). Its core line is ammunition in many calibres (7.62×25, 7.65×17, 9×19, 12.7×99 mm, lethal and less-lethal) plus service firearms. It also sells specialist optical instruments, endoscopes, training simulators, military vehicle parts and sports equipment.

offering.about: Transcarpat Sportours International SRL is a Bucharest company, founded in 2003, that supplies firearms and ammunition to the Romanian Ministry of National Defence, Ministry of Internal Affairs bodies and other state security services. It is the main Romanian partner of Colt CZ Group: under a partnership announced in November 2024 it assembles CZ weapons in Romania, including the CZ BREN 2 rifle, Scorpion EVO3 submachine gun and CZ pistols.

product_portfolio.details: CZ BREN 2 is described as the first NATO-standard assault rifle made in Romania, via the Colt CZ Group partnership.
9x19mm. The CZ P-10C is called the best-selling pistol in Romania. Up to 6,800 9x19mm pistols contracted for the Border Police.
Supplied to the Bucharest General Police Directorate.

offering.production_capabilities: Assembles Colt CZ Group weapons in Romania (CZ BREN 2, BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3, P-07/P-09/P-10C/P-10F) under a partnership announced 22 Nov 2024. The assembly site and capacity were not published.
markets: Romania - Ministry of National Defence and special forces units
Romania - National Police, Border Police, Gendarmerie (incl. Special Intervention Brigade)
Romania - Romsilva forest rangers, local police, court security

current_offers.item: Local assembly of CZ weapons in Romania
current_offers.description: Partnership with Colt CZ Group to assemble the CZ BREN 2 / BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3 and CZ pistols in Romania for state customers.
Won a tender (about RON 10 million) for up to 6,800 9x19mm pistols, delivered over 18 months.

offering.revenue: About RON 28 million turnover with over RON 6 million profit for the previous financial year (reported Sept 2023, likely FY2022)
offering.notes: No official website found (transcarpat.ro does not resolve). All facts come from Romanian press. No source confirmed the optics product line mentioned in TED notices. Compliance and reputational caveats: in 2013 the Romanian Competition Council fined the company together with foreign firms (about EUR 2.8 million in total) for bid-rigging on 2005-2007 MoD tenders. In April 2026 its managers were indicted for keeping military automatic weapons for personal use and for illegal shooting. It is unclear whether the company is a full manufacturer or mainly an assembler/distributor of CZ products; it is classified here as manufacturer_and_distributor because of the local assembly.

proven: Small-arms ammunition across many calibres for the Romanian MoD, police and penitentiary police: 7.62×25, 7.65×17, 7.62×39, 9×19, 7.62×51 blank, 12.7×99 linked, .338 LM, 12-gauge less-lethal
Uncooled thermal surveillance equipment for the Romanian Police (about RON 5.6M) and vehicle-barrier kits
51 lots since 2024, mostly 24–48-month frameworks; wins in competitive tenders (20 lots with several bidders)
offered: Colt CZ Group's partner in Romania: local assembly of the CZ BREN 2 / BREN 2 PDW, Scorpion EVO3 and CZ P-07/P-09/P-10 pistols (partnership from November 2024)

risk_flags.flag: Fined by the Romanian Competition Council in 2013 for bid-rigging on 2005–2007 MoD tenders
Company managers indicted in April 2026 for keeping military automatic weapons for personal use and illegal shooting

catalogue.summary: Broad Romanian state supplier of small-arms ammunition: 9×19, 12.7×99 linked, 7.62×51 blank and precision, 7.65×17, 7.62×25, 7.62×39, .338 LM HPBT and 12-gauge less-lethal, mostly under 24-48-month frameworks with the MoD, police, penitentiary police and IGSU. It also delivers 9×19 SMGs and pistols, PROPARMS 20 mm EOD disruptor consumables, uncooled thermal imagers, vehicle-blocking kits, VAMTAC vehicle spare parts and range/training systems. It is Colt CZ Group's Romanian partner (CZ BREN 2, Scorpion EVO 3, P-10C).

offering.about: Nammo Palencia SLU runs an ammunition factory in central Palencia (Castilla y León), about 250 km north of Madrid. The site began as a 1920s army cavalry barracks and was bought by the Norwegian-Finnish Nammo group from General Dynamics Santa Bárbara Sistemas in 2013. It makes ammunition for the Spanish Armed Forces and international customers and supplies parts and components to other Nammo plants in Europe.

recent_notices.title: Elektrický paralyzátor vystreľovací s príslušenstvom

contracts.title: Pištoľové strelivo
contracts.description:
Časť predmetu zákazky č. 1 – Pištoľové strelivo 
Predmetom zákazky časti predmetu zákazky č. 1 je dodanie nasledovných typov pištoľového streliva: 
•	náboj 9x19 mm Luger 8,0 g,
•	náboj 9x19 mm Luger DUTY,
•	náboj 9x19 mm Luger SUBSONIC,
bližšie definovaných v prílohe č. 3a SP – Špecifikácia predmetu zákazky.
Každý náboj jednotlivého typu streliva musí byť na dne nábojnice označený výrobcom náboja, posledným dvojčíslom roku výroby a kalibrom, pričom razenie na dne nábojnice musí byť zreteľné a ľahko čitateľné. 
Verejný obstarávateľ požaduje, aby náboje boli dodané v hermetickom obale, na ktorom musia byť uvedené minimálne tieto údaje:
-	označenie výrobcu,
-	označenie náboja; hmotnosť a typ strely,
-	počet zabalených kusov,
-	rok výroby,
-	a iné údaje vyplývajúce zo zákonov a vyhlášok.

offering.about: Panna Plus d.o.o. (founded 2006, Ljubljana) is a regional defence, law-enforcement and civil-security solution provider and system integrator that represents more than 85 international defence OEMs. It offers sales and consulting, system integration, life-cycle management (MRO, upgrades, retrofit) and training/certification, serving armed forces, interior ministries and civil-protection bodies mainly in Slovenia and the Adriatic region.

catalogue.summary: Panna Plus is a Ljubljana defence integrator that supplies heavy munitions to the Slovenian MoD through OEM partners: 155 mm modular propellant charges (EUR 15.98M), M4A2/M119A2/M203 bagged 155 mm charges (13,000 units, EUR 13.0M) and MK-82 bomb kits (EUR 14.55M), plus 9×19 mm NATO ball and EOD demolition explosives. It also provides the C2 upgrade of the ship Triglav, aviation and NVLS MAXIMUS night-vision maintenance, Kärcher Futuretech equipment support, metal detectors, X-ray and IMS trace detection, and airfield/logistics equipment.

catalogue.summary: Purnavu muiža is a Latvian hunting retailer and wholesaler that holds Interior Ministry 3-year framework places for 9×19 mm FMJ, 5.56×45 mm (boxed and belt-linked) and 12-gauge ammunition, plus three unpublished 2025 ammunition parts. It supplied 9×19 mm and 12/70 rubber rounds to the Prison Administration, a sniper riflescope and 7×50 binoculars to security and defence buyers, workwear and PPE call-offs to Latvian State Forests, and 40 moose GPS collars. Its 100+ brand range (Lapua, Fiocchi, Zeiss, Swarovski, Kahles, Aimpoint, Pulsar, A-TEC) means civilian-grade optics, suppressors and sporting ammunition can be sourced quickly, but its defence volumes are small.

catalogue.summary: Fiocchi Munizioni (Lecco, Italy; owned by CSG) is a NATO small-calibre ammunition maker that won all six of its Spanish lots in open competition. These cover 7.62×51 mm NATO belted 4:1 ball/tracer (EUR 37.1M Army framework), boxed and linked ball (EUR 10.98M), M13-linked frangible training rounds, and 5.56×45 mm and 7.62×51 mm NATO for the Guardia Civil (EUR 8.3M incl. VAT over 3 years). It also offers 9×19 mm NATO, lead-free frangible LE ammunition, sniper/SOF loads and a new 5.56 mm counter-drone multi-projectile round.

contracts.contract_title: Raamleping Baltic Fox OÜ

offering.about: Baltic Fox OÜ (est. 2008) is a small Estonian retailer and supplier of weapons, ammunition, hunting, outdoor and safety products holding a civilian weapons-handling licence. It sells gas/pepper sprays, firearms, air guns, ammunition, holsters, gun cases and cleaning products, and supplies Estonian police and defence bodies with items such as IR laser sights, thermal/SWIR optics and body-camera systems.

product_portfolio.details: Website shows 'GLOCK Stocking Dealer' branding

products: ASHS hybrid thermal/SWIR binocular with 35mm lens, integrated IR marker and laser rangefinder
product_portfolio.details: IR laser sight tender for Estonian Police and Border Guard Board required 845 (±25) nm IR wavelength

products: Body camera system compatible with electroshock weapon solution
product_portfolio.details: Awarded by Estonian Police and Border Guard Board (Part II, approx. EUR 700k)

certifications: Estonian activity licence for civilian weapons handling
markets: Estonian Police and Border Guard Board (PPA)
Latvian and Lithuanian public agencies (per TED awards)

current_offers.item: Body camera system (compatible with electroshock weapons)
current_offers.description: Contract award from Estonian Police and Border Guard Board, approx. EUR 700,000
Bid declared successful in PPA tender 'IR lasersihikute soetamine' (ref. 278422), decision 30.12.2024
Quotation to Estonian Defence League sniper platoon for 4 sets, delivery estimated 06.2024

offering.notes: Website is a minimal, outdated (c. 2011-2012) WordPress page listing a Tallinn shop (Raua 1/Pronksi 6) while the registered address is in Kuusalu parish; no current catalogue online. Brands of laser sights and body cameras not identified (body cameras 'compatible with electroshock weapon' suggests Axon but unconfirmed). GLOCK status based only on a 'Glock Stocking Dealer' image on the homepage.

proven: Protective and special equipment for Latvia's Provision State Agency (Interior Ministry procurement): gas masks, protective masks, weapon lights, holsters, tactical ladders
Body-worn and in-vehicle camera systems for the Estonian Police and Border Guard (€0.7M); field holsters; pepper-spray devices and service firearms
Shared €25M soldier-clothing framework (production and development) with Estonia's Centre for Defence Investment; 5.56 mm blank cartridges for Lithuania
offered: Small distributor (4 staff) of firearms, air guns, ammunition, pepper spray, holsters, IR laser sights and thermal/SWIR binoculars; GLOCK dealer

catalogue.summary: Baltic Fox is a small Estonian distributor (4 staff, GLOCK stocking dealer) with a broad Baltic public-sector record: police service firearms with GLOCK, OC pepper-spray frameworks, body-worn and in-vehicle camera systems for the Estonian PPA, and 5.56×45 blank ammunition for Lithuania. For the Latvian Interior Ministry it supplies a 7.62 mm machine gun, FN MINIMI barrels, a 40 mm launcher, gas grenades and smoke candles, escape gas masks, holsters, weapon lights, sniper tripods and protective gear. It also holds places on Estonian defence frameworks for firearm accessories (84 months) and soldier clothing.

offering.about: Accuracy International (AI) is a British manufacturer of precision bolt-action sniper, anti-materiel and competition rifles, founded by British international target shooters in Portsmouth, England, where design, development, testing and manufacturing take place; a US facility handles assembly and testing for the American market. It rose to prominence with the UK MoD L96A1 contract in 1985 and says it has supplied tactical rifles to more than 70 nations. In May 2026 FN Browning Group announced an agreement to acquire AI, which will keep operating under its own brand.
offering.parent_group: FN Browning Group (acquisition agreement announced 28 May 2026, subject to regulatory approval)

product_portfolio.details: Multi-calibre bolt-action systems with Quickloc barrel change. AX MKIII evolved from the AXMC and is tested to current NATO requirements for military sniper rifles; it is .338 Lapua Magnum as standard, convertible to .300 Win Mag or .308. AXSR was selected by the Australian Defence Force under LAND 159. Calibres across the range include .223 Rem, .308 Win, .300 Win Mag, .338 Lapua Magnum and .50 BMG.
AX 50 ELR in .50 BMG, convertible to .408 CheyTac or .375 CheyTac; Arca-Swiss tripod rail, 10-round double-stack magazines.
Civilian versions for precision rifle series and other competition and long-range sport shooting.

products: Rifle spare parts and attachments (e.g. AXMC parts supplied to Lithuania)
product_portfolio.details: The ISO 9001 scope covers procurement and repair services and training provision, as well as design and manufacture of firearms and accessories.

offering.production_capabilities: Design, development, testing and manufacturing at its Portsmouth, England headquarters. A US facility does assembly and testing for the US market. Products are subject to UK export controls (Export Control Act 2002 / Export Control Order 2008).
certifications: BS EN ISO 9001:2015 (design and manufacture of firearms and accessories, procurement and repair services, training)
The Queen's Award for Enterprise: International Trade (2015)
markets: Military and government customers in more than 70 nations
US Customs and Border Protection (2023 contract)
Lithuania Defence Resources Agency (AXMC parts, per TED)
Civilian competition shooters (UK/RoW and USA divisions)

current_offers.description: New-generation short-action rifle whose action shares major features with the AXSR and AX ELR: greater breech strength, better gas handling, lower weight.
Agreement for AI to join FN Browning Group as an independent subsidiary, keeping its brand and UK and US manufacturing bases. Subject to regulatory approval.

offering.notes: Not EU-based (UK). The founding year differs by source: the company site says 1980, Wikipedia says 1978. The FN Browning deal was announced in May 2026 and its completion was not confirmed. The calibre list comes from Wikipedia and product datasheets, not the homepage.

offering.about: Zarimex Ltd, founded in 1998 and based in Sofia, trades in firearms, hunting and gas weapons, air rifles, blank cartridges, hunting and small-arms cartridges, optics, clothing and tactical equipment. It runs a retail shop and online store as well as a wholesale business. The company says it is the official Bulgarian representative of a large number of foreign brands, supplies more than 150 Bulgarian companies, and supplies the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior, Ministry of Defence, Special Forces and other state security bodies.

product_portfolio.details: Rifle, pistol/revolver, rimfire and shotgun cartridges, gas-signal and blank ammunition, airgun pellets, plus reloading components (primers, cases, bullets, gunpowder from Nobel Sport, dies and presses from Forster and Redding).
Hunting rifles, shotguns, AR- and AK-type rifles, pistols and revolvers, modular rifle systems, barrels, bolt heads and stocks.
Gas-alarm pistols and revolvers, air rifles and pistols, airsoft, crossbows.
Suppressors, modules, muzzle brakes and adapters.
Riflescopes, red dots, thermal and clip-on sights, thermal binoculars, night vision, binoculars, rangefinders, spotting scopes, mounts (Spuhr, Ernst Apel, Rusan).

products: Holsters (Fobus, IMI Defence, Masc, Concealment Express, Vega)
product_portfolio.details: Batons, stun guns, sprays, handcuffs and holsters.

products: Labradar, Shooting Chrony and MagnetoSpeed chronographs
product_portfolio.details: Helmets, hearing protection, shooting timers, targets, chronographs and accessories.

product_portfolio.category: Hunting clothing, footwear, knives and outdoor gear
product_portfolio.details: Retail hunting and outdoor range.

markets: Bulgarian Ministry of Interior (incl. Gendarmerie / Special Operations directorate, per TED)
Bulgarian Special Forces and anti-terrorist units
State protection agency (guarding the President and Prime Minister)
Bulgarian Biathlon, Shooting and Dynamic Shooting Federations
Retail and online hunters and sport shooters (EU shipping, EUR/USD pricing)

current_offers.description: E-shop in Bulgarian, English and German, offering free ground shipping above a threshold (EUR 250 in April 2026), plus New Arrivals, Discounts, Outlet and Clearance sections, a used-weapons marketplace and TBI leasing.

offering.notes: The live site zarimex.eu (zarimex.com redirects there) blocks automated access with a Cloudflare challenge, so content was read from Wayback Machine snapshots from April 2026. The site gives the name Zarimex Ltd, Sofia, founded 1998, and names the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Defence as customers, which matches the TED profile. The EIK 121535135 itself was not shown on the pages reviewed. The brand list is the company's own claim of official Bulgarian representation. The company also says it is one of the organisers of Bulgarian hunting fairs. No manufacturing capability was found.

Riot helmets with visors for the Bulgarian Interior Ministry (BGN 4.5M), reusable and disposable handcuffs

Beyond these proven lines it claims official Bulgarian representation of about 100 brands, including RWS/GECO/Norma ammunition, Walther/ZEV firearms, Schmidt & Bender/Aimpoint/Trijicon optics, Ops-Core helmets, suppressors and police equipment.

offering.about: Prokopis G. Gavriilides Ltd (also spelled Procopis G. Gavrielides Ltd) is a private limited company registered in Cyprus in December 1976 and located in the Larnaca industrial area. Trade-data aggregators classify its trade under HS chapter 93 (arms and ammunition), with exports under HS 9306 (cartridges/ammunition) to buyers in South Asia, and one aggregator says it focuses on shotgun cartridges. On TED it supplies 5.56x45 mm cartridges (M193 ball and SS109/M855 with tracer) to the Cyprus Police and the Cyprus Ministry of Defence.

products: 5.56x45 mm SS109 (M855) full metal jacket, linked, with tracer (4+1)
product_portfolio.details: From TED award notices (Cyprus Police tender D.O 7/2026: 500,000 M193 and 38,000 SS109/M855 linked with tracer; Cyprus MoD K1Y213, 2024). The manufacturer of origin is not stated in the sources found.
Trade-data aggregators report exports under HS 9306 (to India and other South Asian buyers), with a focus on shotgun cartridges. No specific product lines were confirmed.

markets: Export buyers in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh (per trade-data aggregator)
offering.notes: No company website was found. The Cyprus registry mirror lists this company as HE 8697 (registered 9 Dec 1976, active, registered office in Larnaca), not 16138; Companies House Cyprus HE16138 is an unrelated struck-off company. The TED identifier 16138 may therefore be another ID, such as an e-procurement or supplier number. A business directory lists it under 'Gaming [hunting] guns & equipment' in the Aradippou/Larnaca industrial area. offering.about: Rheinmetall Denel Munition (RDM) is a South African joint venture formed in 2008: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH holds 51% and the state-owned Denel holds 49%. It develops, designs and manufactures large- and medium-calibre ammunition families, including artillery, mortar, infantry (40 mm), naval ammunition, minefield breaching systems, pyrotechnics and propellants. It took over the former Denel units Somchem, Swartklip, Naschem and Boksburg, and serves mainly Asia, the Middle East, South America and Africa, with growing sales to European NATO customers.

contracts.title: T.050/2025 Request for Tenders for the Supply of of Motorcycle Protective Equipment (PPE) for Garda Personnel
contracts.description: This tender is for the Supply of Motorcycle Protective Equipment (PPE) for Garda Personnel, covering the body to the neck, wrists and ankles only. Sizing and fitting services are a requirement of this tender. An Garda Síochána are now seeking to introduce a new generation of textile suits to replace the leather suit previously issued to our motorcyclists. This suit must afford the highest level of protection to Garda members whilst also ensuring that it is robust and comfortable for the challenges presented by the Irish climate. Tenderers should note for operational reasons that year one suit quantities will need to be in place on or before 1st May 2026. Tenderers should also note that they must apply for a Unique Anonymous Tender ID as set out in the RFT Document.

contracts.title: Container Breaching Training System
contracts.description: Supply of container breaching training system to Defence Forces Ireland. The breaching systems sought should include a variety of doors and access points such as frames for breaching training. The system should allow for a full spectrum of breaching types including Mechanical, Explosive, Thermal, Ballistic and Surreptitious methods of breaching training. The breaching systems should be containerised and have the ability to be moved with relative ease without undue risk of damage to the training unit(s).

offering.about: Rivolier (Manufacture Speciale d'Armes Fines et Cycles Rivolier Pere et Fils) is a family-owned group founded in 1830 and based in Saint-Just-Saint-Rambert (Loire), which became a distributor-importer in the early 1990s. It is one of France's leading distributors of hunting, sport-shooting and security/defence equipment, operating a 'Nature' division and a B2B 'Rivolier Securite-Defense' division supplying individual and collective equipment to law enforcement and armed forces. In June 2025 it acquired, with Dutch investor RSBC, the Saint-Etienne small-arms manufacturer Verney-Carron (incl. the Lebel tactical brand).

products: Glock handguns (supplied to French municipal police per TED notices)

contracts.description:
FMI har som følge af den sikkerhedspolitiske situation i Arktis brug for at anskaffe 20 stk. cooling trays med dertilhørende power units til MIDS JTRS-radioer for at understøtte Link 16-kapabiliteten. En cooling tray er en monteringsenhed, hvori MIDS JTRS-radioen installeres, og som sikrer køling af udstyret under drift. MIDS JTRS er grundkomponenten i Link 16-systemet, som muliggør udveksling af taktiske data mellem skibe, fly og helikoptere i realtid.

Situationen vurderes at være en operativ nødsituation og afgørende for sikring af dansk suverænitet og tilstedeværelse i Arktis. Funktionsdygtige cooling trays med tilhørende power units er essentielle for Link 16-kapabiliteten på fartøjerne, der opererer i Arktis. contracts.notice_title: Acquisition of Man-Portable Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicles
contracts.title: Acquisition of Man-Portable Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicles
contracts.description:
Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) har indgået en kontrakt med Precision Technic Defence om anskaffelse af 8 (otte) "Man Portable Remotely Operated Underwater Vehicle systemer" (MP ROV), herunder en tilhørende rammeaftale på undervisning, service og spareparts.
Systemet omfatter bl.a.:

• ROV
• Tether
• Batterier
• Controller
• Software
• Sonar
• Kamera
• Transit case
• Manipulatorarm
• Disruptor

Kapaciteten skal bl.a. sikre mulighed for clearing af havne, inspektion af skibsskrog, periodisk overvågning af bassiner samt sømine og ammunitionsrydning (EOD). Endvidere skal MP ROV kapaciteten understøtte opgaver relateret til “Subsurface and Seabed Warfare” og bidrage til en hurtig og mobil udrykningskapacitet til beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur.

The framework agreement is concering the acquisition of 3 (three) types of Breathable Drysuits:
- A Combat Swimmer Drysuit.
- A Boarding Drysuit.
- A Boat Operator Drysuit.

The framework agreement will also concern Accessories, such as hoods and gloves as well as Spare Parts and Services.

The Drysuits will be used for at broad variaty of tasks in the Danish Defence such as diving, tactical swimming, boarding operation, close quarter combat.
contracts.contract_title: Framework agreement regarding Breathable Drysuits.

contracts.notice_title: Kontrakt om levering af handsker (Genudbud)
contracts.title: Kontrakt om levering af handsker (Genudbud)
contracts.description: Rigspolitiet udbyder en 6-årig kontrakt om levering af handsker som benyttes af politipersonale i deres daglige virke. udbuddet omhandler 3 typer af handsker. For nærmere beskrivelse af produkterne henvises til Bilag 1: Kravspecifikation. - Leverandøren skal levere produkterne inden for en maksimal leveringstid. Derudover skal leverandøren have en kapacitet, så der kan ske hasteleverancer, som ligger ud over de almindelige leverancer. For yderligere information henvises til udbudsmaterialet, særligt kontrakten samt Bilag 1. - Tilbudsgiver skal være opmærksom på, at der skal indleveres vareprøver i forbindelse med tilbudsafgivningen.

contracts.notice_title: Amendment to Acquisition and sustainment agreement regarding acquisition and sustainment of mobile sensor systems
contracts.buyer: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation
contracts.title: Amendment to Acquisition and sustainment agreement regarding acquisition and sustainment of mobile sensor systems
contracts.description: DALO has signed an amendment to the existing framework agreement with Precision Technic Defence A/S in which the warranty period is set start running upon installation of the product. The 6-year liability period for system defects is not included in the amendment and will remain unchanged. According to DALO's assessment the amendment does not entail a change of fundamental elements in the existing framework agreement, as the change alone entails a more burdensome liability obligation for the supplier than the framework agreement originally authorized, and it is DALO’s assessment that the change is legal under procurement law.

offering.about: Precision Technic Defence A/S is the Danish core of the Precision Technic Defence Group, founded in 1985 in Rodovre as Precision Technic Nordic and focused on defence and security since 2012. The group supplies integrated defence solutions from over 250 partner manufacturers worldwide, covering soldier systems, C4ISR, platform and sensor systems, unmanned systems, training and local service and support, with subsidiaries in Germany, Australia, the UK, France, Poland, Sweden and the USA.

catalogue.summary: Precision Technic Defence is a Danish soldier- and platform-systems integrator that delivers urgent Danish MoD requirements. TED shows 350 Fjord Defence HMG/40 mm GMG field mounts (EUR 2.4M), 600 HMG dual-sight wings, 8 man-portable EOD/inspection ROV systems with a service framework (DKK 36M), a 4-year breathable drysuit framework (DKK 20M), and 20 Link 16 MIDS JTRS cooling trays. It also holds a place on Sweden's FMV load-carrying framework and represents Teledyne FLIR surveillance systems, drawing on more than 250 partner manufacturers.
